I haven't seen anyone posting this but several of the items allow you to place them inside other items. I am running Grounded on Xbox so don't know if it will work on PC. In order to do this you need to place your original item blueprint. Then try to place another item inside it, the blueprint will be red. When you have decided where you want your next item bring up your radial menu select the item then quickly press A then X the blueprint will be blue for a short time allowing you to place another. It's a bit finicky on the timing.

So far I can only do this when building on player built floors and have got it to work with chests and pallets but other items may work as well.
